_comment: Single source of truth for the Studio's curated TTS voice map — read by BOTH the browser bundle (docs/src/components/studio/tts-voice-catalog.ts) and Node tooling (tools/generate-voice-samples.mjs, tools/check-ownership.js's checkVoiceSampleAssets). A model id resolves to an engine via 'match' (an OR-of-AND rule list: each object's keys AND together, the array ORs). requiresAsset=true means tools/generate-voice-samples.mjs generates docs/public/voice-samples/<engine>/<voice-id>.mp3 for every voice and tools/check-ownership.js requires that count to match. A voices:[] engine with a 'hint' has NO named-voice concept at all (voice-cloning / speaker-slot models) — the UI shows that hint instead of the generic 'unrecognized model' message. See engineering/decisions/2026-07-09-studio-cloud-ondevice-config-split.md.

kokoro._note: Runs on-device and never spends credits WHEN it can run at all — it doesn't load on iPhone or on devices with too little memory (kokoroSupported()/probeKokoroCache() gate this, and the picker is disabled with an explanatory hint there already). A cached sample wouldn't fix that gap (real narration would still fail on those devices), so requiresAsset stays false rather than pretending the asset cache buys universal availability. The voice roster below is still used for the dropdown wherever Kokoro does run.

openai._note: No openai/* model is in OpenRouter's current speech catalog — kept for if one is added later. requiresAsset stays false until then; the generator skips any engine whose modelId doesn't resolve on the live catalog.

gemini._audioFormatNote: This model's speech endpoint 400s on response_format:"mp3" — it only returns raw PCM (confirmed live: 'Gemini TTS only supports response_format="pcm"'). tools/generate-voice-samples.mjs requests pcm and wraps it in a WAV container (sample rate/channels read from the response's Content-Type header, not hardcoded) instead of mp3 for this engine.
gemini._note: A representative 10-of-30 subset of Google's published Gemini TTS voice set, shared across the Gemini TTS model family — not verified as the exact live roster for THIS preview variant specifically.

orpheus._note: "zoe" was in the model's own GitHub README roster (source for the other 7 voices here, all confirmed live) but consistently 500s on OpenRouter's hosted endpoint regardless of casing — confirmed with a direct API round-trip, not a transient failure. Dropped rather than shipped as a curated option that always fails to synthesize.

zonos.hint: This model clones a voice from a reference audio sample — it doesn't have named presets. A voice id here won't do anything.

csm.hint: This model takes a numeric speaker slot (e.g. "0") plus reference audio, not a named voice — results are inconsistent without one.
